events.info: Lights. Camera. Magic! Step into the spotlight as Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Daisy, and Goofy welcome you to a star studded Disney On Ice gala experience. Add a hint of red-carpet flair as you get ready for an unforgettable evening with your favorite Disney friends. The magic shines brighter than ever as beloved stories from Zootopia 2, Tangled, Beauty and the Beast, Toy Story, and Monsters, Inc. unfold in spectacular fashion, bringing Hollywood inspired glamour to the ice. Be among the honored guests as Stitch introduces Angel for her shimmering on ice debut, and prepare for a scene stealing entrance by the Disney Villains that will keep you on the edge of your seat. When the spotlight turns to celebrate you, it's your moment to bask in the glitz, excitement, and enchantment of Disney On Ice presents Spotlight Magic! *Note: Costumes not permitted for guests 14 years & older. Visit ww.DisneyOnIce.com for more information.

venues.name: M&T Bank Stadium

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Open Mon thru Fri:9AM to 5PM During the season open on Saturday of a home game from 10AM to 4PM Game Days: 2.5 hours prior to kickoff
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available 3 hours prior to kickoff: Must have a Valid Photo-ID for pick-up, confirmation # and credit card used for purchase are recommended for pick-up of phone charge orders.

venues.parkingDetail: Stadium lots are reserved for Season Ticket Holders. There are paylots and garages in the area, prices vary. • All accessible parking is sold ($45 per vehicle) on a first-come, first-served basis, and cannot be purchased in advance. Parking Lots open 4.5 hrs prior to kickoff. Guests with a parking pass for a non-accessible lot can show that pass to avoid an additional charge, if accessible spaces are available. • Access to accessible parking spaces is limited to vehicles with disabled license plates or valid accessible hangtags. A valid Ravens game ticket must also be presented. The person to whom the disabled tag was issued must be in the vehicle & may be asked to provide a state MVA disabled registration card.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: • ADA seating may be available for purchase & exchanges & is subject to availability. Ravens games are typically sold out of all seating, including ADA seats. • Guests requiring ADA seats for all stadium events with assigned seating are strongly encouraged to contact the ticket office at 410-261-RAVE (7283) to ensure proper accommodations. • Wheelchairs, motorized wheelchairs & scooters are permitted inside M&T Bank Stadium. Guests may check their mobility device at any Guest Services Center (Sections 100, 127, 525, 553) or Club Concierge (204, 224, 229, 250) & pick up at the conclusion of the event. • M&T Bank Stadium has more than 100 accessible parking spaces, located in lots B, C, R. • The following gates are accessible for guests with disabilities: Gates A, B, C, D, F, A1, A2, Media Gate (South side of the stadium). Medical needs lines at all main gates (A, B, C, D) • There are 6 banks of elevators in M&T Bank Stadium; 3 on the north & 3 on the south side. North elevators are located near sections 102, 146, & 151. South elevators are located near sections 119, 124, & 129. Please note there are stairs to enter the elevator lobby at section 124. The elevators at sections 102, 119, 129, 146, & 151 have no stairs and are accessible for all guests.

generalInfo.childRule: Children 2 & under do not need a ticket but are required to sit on the lap of their guardian.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box Office Hours: Tuesday through Friday 10am to 4pm Shows that take place on a Saturday or Sunday, the box office will open 3 hours prior to the event. Address: 140 W. Mount Royal Ave Baltimore, MD 21201 Phone Number: 410-900-1150
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: The Box Office will open 2 hours prior to any show and will remain open 30 minutes past the start of show. Customers must present the credit card used to purchase the tickets and a valid photo ID. (Shows that take place on a Saturday or Sunday, the box office will open 3 hours prior to the event.)

venues.parkingDetail: A limited number of parking spaces are available along Mount Royal Avenue (including several handicapped accessible locations) and other nearby streets. Please carefully check the associated signage for information about time and availability. A private parking garage is also available (The Fitzgerald parking garage) and is located on 80 W. Oliver Street.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: If you are in need of accessible seating please call (410) 900-1165 Accessible seating tickets will be held at Will Call and can be picked up 2 hours before the performance.

generalInfo.generalRule: ARRIVE EARLY All packages, including briefcases and pocketbooks, will be inspected prior to entry. Please be mindful of traffic conditions, as downtown Baltimore can be quite congested, especially during special events and the holiday season. All patrons will continue to go through a screening process upon entry. As delays are expected, The Lyric requests that for all events, ticket holders arrive as early as possible. Guests are strongly discouraged from bringing packages, briefcases, knapsacks and video equipment to the venue. No smoking permitted anywhere in The Lyric No recording devices permitted No outside food or drink permitted
generalInfo.childRule: A child under one year of age does not require a ticket, but will sit on the parent or guardians lap during the show. If a child has celebrated their first birthday, a ticket is required. Some shows are age restricted. Please refer to the venue website for more information.

ada.adaCustomCopy:
To better accommodate your needs, The Lyric has requested that all special seating accommodations be solicited only through their representatives. Please contact a The Lyric representative for further help with your ticket purchase.*   Advance ticket purchase may be required.

* Box office information is subject to change.

Monday-Friday: 10am-6pm Sat: 10am-4pm Closed Sundays (except when there is a Sunday event—for which ticket office opens two hours prior to event). For nighttime events, the ticket office remains open until intermission of the event.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets may be picked up beginning one hour prior to event at MFAC box office (located at the MFAC main entrance). Customers must present the credit card used to purchase the tickets as well as a photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Free, off-street parking is available in the parking lot marked “Y-Lot.” Access lot by turning right onto McCallum Dr. (on left side of MFAC). Travel up hill, pass the 'X' Parking Lot (PERMIT PARKING ONLY) on right. At end of 'X' Parking Lot, bear right at black fence. Look for 'Y' Parking Lot-which is the general parking lot for Murphy Fine Arts Center events. As you walk toward the building, enter the MFAC through bank of doors (in the that face the plaza)

generalInfo.generalRule: Late Seating: To ensure minimal disruption to our patrons once a performance has started, latecomers will be seated at the discretion and direction of the Front of House Manager during an appropriate break in the performance. There are no refunds or discounts for late arrivals. Please note that original seating cannot be guaranteed for latecomers.
generalInfo.childRule: Everyone--regardless of age--must have a ticket. Children (or anyone) causing distractions or disruptions (i.e. making sounds, crying, talking of any type) must exit the theatre. Please keep in mind that many performances and events are not appropriate for babies and young children.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Purchase tickets at the Murphy Fine Arts Center (MFAC) ticket office located at the front entrance (on the 2nd floor) of the MFAC located at 2201 Argonne Drive. Monday-Friday: 10am-6pm Sat: 10am-4pm Closed Sundays (except when there is a Sunday event—for which ticket office opens two hours prior to event). For nighttime events, the ticket office remains open until intermission of the event.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call tickets may be picked up beginning one hour prior to event at MFAC box office (located at the MFAC main entrance). Customers must present the credit card used to purchase the tickets as well as a photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Free, off-street parking is available in the parking lot marked “Y-Lot.” Access lot by turning right onto McCallum Dr. (on left side of MFAC). Travel up hill, pass the 'X' Parking Lot (PERMIT PARKING ONLY) on right. At end of 'X' Parking Lot, bear right at black fence. Look for 'Y' Parking Lot-which is the general parking lot for Murphy Fine Arts Center events. As you walk toward the building, enter the MFAC through bank of doors (in the that face the plaza)

generalInfo.generalRule: Late Seating: To ensure minimal disruption to our patrons once a performance has started, latecomers will be seated at the discretion and direction of the Front of House Manager during an appropriate break in the performance. There are no refunds or discounts for late arrivals. Please note that original seating cannot be guaranteed for latecomers.
generalInfo.childRule: Everyone--regardless of age--must have a ticket. Children (or anyone) causing distractions or disruptions (i.e. making sounds, crying, talking of any type) must exit the theatre. Please keep in mind that many performances and events are not appropriate for babies and young children.

ticketLimit.info: Please note: There is a ticket limit of 6 tickets per person and per credit card on this event.
